es.summary: La CID es una activación sistémica de la coagulación que produce microtrombos y consumo de plaquetas y factores, provocando sangrado y falla orgánica. En obstetricia se asocia a placenta abrupta, eclampsia y parto prolongado.
key_points: Activación masiva de la cascada de coagulación → consumo de plaquetas y factores
Manejo: tratar causa subyacente + reposición de componentes sanguíneos

pathophysiology: Trombina genera fibrina y microtrombos en capilares
Consumo rápido de plaquetas y factores de coagulación
risk_factors: Embarazo prolongado o trabajo de parto prolongado
signs_symptoms: Sangrado vaginal o de sitio quirúrgico
diagnostics: Tiempo de tromboplastina parcial activada (aPTT) prolongado
treatment: Reposición de plaquetas y plasma fresco congelado (PFC)
Transfusión de concentrado de eritrocitos si Hb <7 g/dL
Control de la causa obstétrica (ej. evacuación de placenta)
Heparina de bajo peso solo en fase de consumo excesivo y sin sangrado activo
complications: Fallo multiorgánico por microtrombosis (riñón, hígado, pulmón)
nursing_care: Monitoreo continuo de PA, FC, saturación y diuresis
Valoración de sangrado: drenajes, succión, sangrado vaginal
patient_teaching: Informar signos de sangrado anormal (moretones, sangre en orina)
Importancia de acudir a controles postparto para pruebas de coagulación
Mantener hidratación adecuada y evitar automedicación con AINES

outcomes: Balance hídrico neto ≥0 mL en 24 h

interventions.action: Colocar acceso venoso de calibre adecuado y mantener vía permeable
interventions.rationale: Facilita la administración rápida de fluidos y sangre

interventions.action: Iniciar reposición de cristaloides isotónicos según protocolo de reposición de choque
interventions.rationale: Restablece el volumen intravascular y perfusión tisular

interventions.action: Administrar concentrado de eritrocitos y plasma fresco según órdenes y resultados de laboratorio
interventions.rationale: Reemplaza componentes sanguíneos perdidos y corrige coagulopatía

interventions.action: Registrar y monitorear balance de líquidos cada hora
interventions.rationale: Detecta rápidamente déficit o exceso de volumen

interventions.action: Evaluar signos de sangrado cada 15 min y notificar al médico
interventions.rationale: Previene deterioro hemodinámico y permite intervención oportuna

en.summary: DIC is a systemic activation of coagulation that produces microthrombi and consumption of platelets and factors, leading to bleeding and organ failure. In obstetrics it is associated with abruptio placentae, eclampsia and prolonged labor.
key_points: Massive activation of the coagulation cascade → consumption of platelets and factors
Management: treat underlying cause + replace blood components

pathophysiology: Thrombin generates fibrin and microthrombi in capillaries
Rapid consumption of platelets and coagulation factors
treatment: Platelet and fresh frozen plasma (FFP) replacement
Packed red blood cell transfusion if Hb <7 g/dL
Low‑molecular‑weight heparin only in the consumption phase and without active bleeding
complications: Multi‑organ failure from microthrombosis (kidney, liver, lung)
nursing_care: Continuous monitoring of BP, HR, saturation and urine output
Assessment of bleeding: drains, suction, vaginal bleeding
patient_teaching: Inform about abnormal bleeding signs (bruising, blood in urine)
Importance of postpartum follow‑up for coagulation tests
Maintain adequate hydration and avoid self‑medication with NSAIDs

outcomes: Net fluid balance ≥0 mL in 24 h

interventions.action: Place an appropriately sized intravenous access and keep the line patent
interventions.rationale: Facilitates rapid administration of fluids and blood

interventions.action: Initiate isotonic crystalloid replacement per shock resuscitation protocol
interventions.rationale: Restores intravascular volume and tissue perfusion

interventions.action: Administer packed red blood cells and fresh frozen plasma per orders and lab results
interventions.rationale: Replaces lost blood components and corrects coagulopathy

interventions.action: Record and monitor fluid balance hourly
interventions.rationale: Detects rapid fluid deficit or excess

interventions.action: Assess bleeding signs every 15 min and notify the physician
interventions.rationale: Prevents hemodynamic deterioration and allows timely intervention

sections.complications.0.quote: If intravascular fluid loss is severe, the body cannot maintain adequate blood pressure and perfusion of vital organs.
